title: VIC - Upgrade the Network
current_summary: Planned maintenance by an upstream provider will update access network equipment in Victoria between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM AEDT on 14 October 2026. A brief service interruption of up to 15 minutes is expected around 1:00 AM AEDT. Our team will monitor the work and services should restore once the window ends.

updates.content: An upstream provider will perform software updates on access network equipment in Victoria between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM AEDT on 14 October 2026. During this window, some services may briefly go offline, with a single interruption of up to 15 minutes expected around 1:00 AM AEDT. We will monitor progress and services should restore once the work is complete. If needed, using mobile data can help you stay connected while your service is offline.
